entries.say.variants.question.identity.dataset.s: I keep my name to myself until I know someone better. What should I call you?
Let's get to know each other first. What do people call you?
entries.say.variants.question.identity.dataset.w: I don't trust you enough to share my name. Who are you, really?
After that lie, I'm not telling you my name. Tell me the truth about yours.
